args.text: CREATE TABLE An (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK PRIMARY KEY, K LONG, S TEXT(50), D DOUBLE)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UK ON An (K)
INSERT INTO An (ID, K, S) VALUES (1, 1, 'r1')
INSERT INTO An (ID, K, S) VALUES (10, 10, 'r10')
DELETE FROM An WHERE ID = 10
CREATE TABLE Src (N LONG CONSTRAINT PKS PRIMARY KEY, ID LONG, K LONG, S TEXT(50))
INSERT INTO Src VALUES (1, 10, 10, 'r10-new')
INSERT INTO Src VALUES (2, 10, 20, 'r10-pkdup')
INSERT INTO An (ID, K, S) SELECT ID, K, S FROM Src ORDER BY N
